title: Zesty Moroccan Lamb Tagine
description: A funky and energizing Moroccan dish featuring lamb, soured cream and chive dip, and binchotan-charcoal grilled flavors, with anti-inflammatory friendly ingredients.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned, about 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the lamb and cook until it is browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil, then cover the tagine or Dutch oven and transfer it to the oven.
Cook the tagine over binchotan-charcoal or in a preheated oven at 300 degrees for 2 1/2 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
While the tagine is cooking, mix the soured cream and chive dip ingredients together in a bowl.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with the soured cream and chive dip and a sprinkle of chopped fresh cilantro.
Offer crusty bread or couscous on the side, if desired.
